silicene.note: DFT cell-relaxed (ISIF=2, from a symmetry-broken buckled seed); a and dMX (inter-sublattice buckling amplitude) match the converged, phonon-stable structure. Corrects the flat-honeycomb template bug (both atoms at identical z, MP's own entry treated as artificially symmetric) that caused pervasive imaginary phonon modes; fully STABLE on a dense 40x40x1 mesh after this buckling correction + a hiphive rotational-sum-rule fit. dz corrected 2026-08-07 from the trapped-relaxation-bug 6.5 placeholder via a 9-point rigid PES scan of the silicene homobilayer (production stacking code, 2.0-6.0 A, 0.5 A steps) + quadratic fit through the 2.5/3.0/3.5 A bracket -- see feedback_trapped_bilayer_relaxation_bug memory.

stanene.note: DFT cell-relaxed value; MP's own cached a (4.645673) was never actually used historically because this material's spacegroup_symbol is null in mp_lattice_params_cache.json, so pre-fix generation silently fell through to the local LATTICE_PARAMS fallback constant (4.70) instead -- this override makes that the explicit, intentional value rather than an accidental fallback. dMX is the inter-sublattice buckling amplitude, needed for the same flat-honeycomb reason as silicene/germanene. Buckling correction alone made this fully STABLE on a dense 40x40x1 mesh, no further hiphive correction needed.

GaSe.note: Post-transition-metal monochalcogenide: real structure is a 4-atom Se-Ga-Ga-Se dimer layer (Ga-Ga bonded vertically), not the 2-atom flat honeycomb the old get_binary_monolayer_coords dispatch (mat[0] in ['Ga','In']) was incorrectly using -- confirmed via live MP fetch of mp-1943's full 8-atom bulk structure (2 stacked layers), site-resolved by z-coordinate. dMX and dMM are both extracted directly from that structure (Se-Ga and Ga-Ga bond lengths respectively). Needs get_monochalcogenide_dimer_coords, not get_binary_monolayer_coords. dz corrected 2026-08-07 from useless 6.5 placeholder to the mean interlayer separation of its own correctly-relaxed AB/BA homobilayers (these are genuinely dynamically unstable, but the relaxed geometry itself is correct) -- see feedback_trapped_bilayer_relaxation_bug memory.

InSe.note: Post-transition-metal monochalcogenide: real structure is a 4-atom Se-In-In-Se dimer layer (In-In bonded vertically), same fix as GaSe (see that entry's note) -- confirmed via live MP fetch of mp-20485's full 8-atom bulk structure. dMX and dMM extracted directly from that structure (In-Se and In-In bond lengths respectively). dz corrected 2026-08-07 from useless 6.5 placeholder to the mean interlayer separation of its own correctly-relaxed AB/BA homobilayers -- see feedback_trapped_bilayer_relaxation_bug memory.

graphene.note: dz-only override added 2026-08-07: this material was one of the 5 workflow-wide trapped-relaxation-bug families (trapped at 6.528 A, sitting in FINAL_RESULTS_HEALTHY as a false positive until removed same day). a/dMX unaffected (2.467/0.0 already correct in cache). dz measured via a 9-point rigid PES scan of the graphene homobilayer (production stacking code, 2.0-6.0 A, 0.5 A steps) + quadratic fit through the 3.0/3.5/4.0 A bracket -> 3.566 A, in the expected range near graphite's known ~3.35 A interlayer spacing (DFT-D3 vs. experiment, close but not identical) -- see feedback_trapped_bilayer_relaxation_bug memory.
